_comment: ILLUSTRATIVE Chapter 11 restructuring demo -- a hypothetical distressed company's capital structure and a real, standard three-tranche seniority stack (secured, senior unsecured, subordinated). Reorg value of $300M is enough to pay secured debt in full but leaves senior unsecured notes as the real fulcrum security (partial recovery) and wipes out the subordinated notes entirely -- the classic real distressed-investing setup.
